task.description: Diagnose ISS-0733 (no DEFINITION_PROMOTED audit/event entry found via any queried surface after a real promotion release). Read docs/issues/ISS-0733.yaml in full. Trace: (1) whether opts[:event_appender] wired to apply_review/4 in production is Letflow.EventStore.PlatformEvents.append_definition_promoted/2, a stub, or something else; (2) whether EventStore.append/2 actually supports the platform_instance_id sentinel append, tracing the current code rather than trusting promotion.ex's moduledoc which may be stale; (3) run or write a real test to observe whether the append succeeds for a genuine apply_review/4 call; (4) if it succeeds, find why GET /api/v1/audit and GET /api/v1/instances/.../timeline can't find it -- is there a real platform-events read path anywhere; (5) if it silently fails, find where/why and whether do_apply_review/3's failure path (marking the review :failed) is what actually happened for the real pilot review. Diagnosis only -- no fix. Report root cause, file/line evidence, and a sizing recommendation (same-session ELIXIR-DEV fix vs CODE-DESIGNER pass vs split via REQ-ANALYST).
acceptance_criteria: Reproduces/traces the real code path rather than diagnosing from the bug report's prose alone
States definitively whether the event append succeeds or fails today, with evidence (test run or direct trace)

result.summary: Root cause: TWO independent missing-write/missing-read-path gaps, not a silently-failing event append. (1) Event-append side is NOT silently failing: lib/letflow/routers/promotions.ex:594-597 wires event_appender: &PlatformEvents.append_definition_promoted/2 (real adapter, not a stub); platform_events.ex:64-100 builds event_attrs matching the DEFINITION_PROMOTED schema_version 2 registered in tenant_provisioning.ex:927-965. Ran `mix test test/letflow/event_store/platform_events_test.exs` for real: 9 passed, driving the real producer chain end to end and confirming a real INSERT INTO events with instance_id = platform_instance_id() commits successfully (instance_projections deliberately stays empty for the sentinel -- event_store.ex:875-876's own documented design). Caveat: this holds only for a tenant whose event_type_registry was backfilled to schema_version 2 (ISS-0332, resolved 2026-08-26) -- whether QA's real tenants had that backfill run is an operational fact outside the repo, not a code bug if unconfirmed. Conclusion: the pilot review almost certainly reports :applied correctly and the event genuinely lands in the events table. (2) GET /api/v1/audit real bug: lib/letflow/routers/audit.ex:15-24 documents that since REQ-196 /audit reads ONLY from the audit_entries table (Letflow.Audit.Entry), never the event store. Rows appear only via explicit Letflow.Audit.insert_entry/3 calls -- grepped every caller: lib/letflow/definitions.ex:1903 (definition lifecycle) and lib/letflow/engine/task_activation.ex. lib/letflow/definitions/promotion.ex and lib/letflow/routers/promotions.ex call Letflow.Audit NOWHERE. This exactly explains the pilot's two audit-query observations (source tenant showed only definition.create/activate; target tenant showed only Engine-generated instance/task/artifact entries) -- promotion.ex's write_target_definition/4 (lines 345-372) inlines its own raw Repo.insert/Repo.update_all with no Audit call, and append_promotion_event/9 (411-446) only calls the event-store adapter. Even a 100%-succeeding append will never show in /audit -- it is structurally wired to the wrong table. (3) GET /api/v1/instances/:platform_instance_id/timeline real bug: instances.ex:169-198's timeline/3 calls ensure_instance_exists/2 first, which requires a real instance_projections row -- and platform_instance_id/0's own doc (event_store.ex:871-879) states it is 'Never inserted into instance_projections' by design. So this endpoint 404s for EVERY caller, always, regardless of whether any platform event was ever appended -- the issue's premise that this endpoint is a documented read surface for platform events is not borne out by current code. No dedicated platform-events read endpoint exists anywhere in lib/letflow/routers/ (grepped, none found). SIZING RECOMMENDATION: needs a CODE-DESIGNER pass, not a same-session ELIXIR-DEV fix. Reasons: (a) a new write path is needed -- should the audit-entry write join promotion.ex's write_target_definition/4 transaction (like every other Audit.insert_entry call site) or follow the event-append's deliberate after-commit pattern (step 9, OQ-1)? That's an unresolved design call the moduledoc already flags, not implementation detail. (b) a new/changed read path is needed -- either a dedicated platform-scoped events endpoint, or special-casing ensure_instance_exists/timeline/3 to bypass the instance_projections check for the platform sentinel -- both carry authz-shape decisions (who can read platform-wide promotion events). (c) multiple files with no single obvious shape: lib/letflow/definitions/promotion.ex, lib/letflow/audit.ex, lib/letflow/instances.ex, and/or a new router file or lib/letflow/routers/promotions.ex / instances.ex. Recommends CODE-DESIGNER resolve both gaps together in one design doc (both trace to EO-004's single acceptance criterion) rather than pre-splitting into separate requirements.

issues.description: lib/letflow/definitions/promotion.ex calls Letflow.Audit nowhere -- promotion writes never produce an audit_entries row, so GET /api/v1/audit structurally can never show a promotion.

GET /api/v1/instances/:platform_instance_id/timeline 404s unconditionally for every caller by design (platform_instance_id is deliberately never inserted into instance_projections) -- no platform-scoped events read endpoint exists anywhere.
